verdict.what_is_wrong: A short-lived ttmem workload underwent intense container-scoped memcg reclaim and then exited almost immediately afterward, which strongly supports a hard memory-limit failure (though the trace lacks an explicit OOM-kill event, so the kill attribution is not conclusive). This is a localized container event, not evidence of host-wide memory pressure; the re-read ratio and scheduler wait-versus-D checks were not established in the notes.
